name: Solenne Spire Governance Biosync Power Suit
description: This is not clothing. This is architecture worn by a person. The Solenne Spire Governance suit is bespoke from the ground up, constructed over four fittings at Solenne Atelier's appointment-only Tier 5 consultation suite. The jacket is a double-breasted silhouette in deep midnight navy, woven from Solenne's proprietary thermolace — a fabric with embedded microfilament heating and cooling channels that maintain the wearer's surface temperature within a half-degree regardless of the room, eliminating any visible stress response from the body. The lapels are faced in a subtle privacy-weave that scatters directional microphones and visual surveillance drones, rendering the wearer's spoken words unintelligible at distances over two meters. Posture-active panels in the shoulders and lumbar distribute weight and provide gentle structural correction, so the wearer always stands exactly as tall as their frame allows. The trousers are cut with a full tail-vent panel running the rear seam — gene-compatible for any geneware modification up to a standard prehensile tail, with a hidden pleat system that adjusts the silhouette automatically. A cream silk-analog pocket square, a single heavy brushed-gold button at each cuff, and Vantrel bespoke biosync oxfords in black complete the look. The whole ensemble syncs to the wearer's BCI, adjusting microclimate, posture support, and privacy-weave activation based on ambient threat assessment.
functionality: Thermoregulation to ±0.5°C, directional microphone and visual drone scatter in lapels, BCI-synced microclimate adjustment, posture-active lumbar and shoulder support, tail-vent rear panel with auto-adjusting pleat silhouette, embedded biometric ID broadcasting on Tier 5 secure frequency
what_it_says: Power this absolute requires no announcement. The suit maintains your body temperature so you never sweat in a negotiation. It straightens your spine so you never slouch in a boardroom. It blurs your words so surveillance can't capture them. You are not dressed for the office. The office is dressed for you.
worn_by: anyone whose calendar entry reads 'closed session' three days a week
manufacturer: Solenne Atelier — bespoke, appointment only, six-week lead time minimum
price_range: Φ 48,000–Φ 95,000 depending on geneware accommodation and BCI integration tier
story_hooks: The privacy-scatter weave in the lapels has a narrow frequency gap — one specific model of surveillance drone, discontinued eight years ago but still operated by one particular intelligence division, can still hear through it. Someone in that division knows what was said in the last board meeting.

A character acquires one of these suits secondhand through channels they'd rather not explain. The BCI sync profile still contains fragments of the previous owner's preference data — microclimate settings, posture correction baselines, and three encrypted calendar entries that never got wiped.

The posture-active panels in this suit were calibrated for a specific body. Worn by someone else, they correct toward the original wearer's posture — subtly, over hours, until the new wearer begins to move like someone they've never met.

physical_description.visual_profile: An immaculate double-breasted silhouette that reads as power distilled into fabric—the jacket sits with surgical precision against the torso, shoulders defined but never aggressive. The deep midnight navy creates an almost liquid darkness that absorbs light rather than reflecting it. The wearer appears perpetually composed, standing with effortless authority. The cream pocket square adds a single note of calculated elegance. Overall impression: a corpo executive who has transcended the need to perform confidence.
physical_description.fit: Meticulously tailored to the individual—perfect through the chest, with posture-correcting panels creating imperceptible structural support. The trousers drape with mathematical precision, breaking cleanly at the ankle. Nothing bunches, pulls, or shifts. The fit adapts subtly to the wearer's movements and augmentations.
physical_description.primary_material: Solenne proprietary thermolace (microfilament-embedded temperature regulation weave); cream silk-analog pocket square; black Vantrel biosync leather (oxfords); brushed-gold hardware
physical_description.texture: The thermolace has a dense, almost glass-smooth surface with imperceptible texture variation—running a hand across it reveals subtle warmth channels beneath. The privacy-weave lapels have a faint directional sheen, like oil on water. The silk-analog square is buttery. Oxfords show deep burnish.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep midnight navy (primary), cream (accent via pocket square), black (shoes), brushed-gold metallic hardware. The overall palette reads as elite minimalism—color restraint as a status signal.
physical_description.closures: BCI-responsive magnetic snaps (main jacket closure, invisible to naked eye); hidden friction-fit adjustments in the tail-vent panel; traditional brushed-gold buttons at cuffs (purely decorative, micro-adjustable for geneware clearance)
distinctive_features: Privacy-weave lapel facing that scatters directional microphones and drone surveillance beyond 2 meters
Embedded microfilament heating/cooling channels maintaining surface temperature within ±0.5°C
Posture-active shoulder and lumbar panels providing structural correction
Full tail-vent panel with gene-compatible design for standard prehensile tail geneware
Hidden pleat system auto-adjusting silhouette based on augmentation profile
BCI integration for threat-assessment-responsive privacy-weave activation
Vantrel biosync oxfords with responsive material bonding to wearer's gait signature
Cream silk-analog pocket square (part of bespoke ensemble, never misplaced)
Four-fitting custom construction—no two suits identical
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—bespoke, appointment-only, six-week minimum lead time. Solenne Atelier operates exclusively at the apex of corpo hierarchy. This is not purchased; it is commissioned.
physical_description.cultural_context: The wearer is a decision-maker—board-level corporate, high-level governance liaison, or executive operating in high-stakes negotiation environments. Someone for whom surveillance is a constant ambient threat. The suit communicates: 'I control not just my appearance, but the space around my body.' It reads corpo-political, precision-engineered confidence.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine. A Solenne suit is maintained at a level most people reserve for heirlooms. Professional cleaning, microclimate recalibration, biosync re-synchronization. Any visible wear is immediate grounds for return to the atelier. These suits age like data—they don't wear, they accumulate value.
